about: workflow:keep-each-ais-identity-profile: keeps each AI's identity profile in the person's own store: its name and persona are set by one write, the write keeps the AI's other fields as they are and is refused without a name, and the rows read back with the reader's defaults (a missing name is Assistant, a missing persona is empty, an unknown status is pending_setup, a row with no id is not read). It replaces tools/ai-identity (packages/ai-identity/do-work/update-ai-identity-profile.ts, which sent the update to the retired Bitfield workflow slot, and read-data/read-ai-identity.ts). The email and wallet handles and the model are kept by their own owners (sign-in, the wallet and the model list), so they are read here, never written (rule a-tool-is-only-what-the-store-cannot-do). The folder stays until its importers, the retired Bitfield packages, stop naming it.

payload.label: Keep each AI's identity profile
payload.job: Keep each AI's identity profile in the person's own store: set its name and persona in one write that keeps its other fields, and read each AI back with its name, persona and status, with the defaults for what is missing.
payload.produces: One identity row per AI in the person's own store, proven on the example writes and seeds in three stores of different kinds, with each write kept or refused and the rows read back.

source.note: The old write was a request to the retired Bitfield workflow slot for the definition action:update-ai-identity-profile. Its one rule, a name is needed, is the store's own check. The reader's defaults are the intent below.

where.description: Where the person keeps the AI identity rows: the store's own address

language.description: How that store is spoken to, in its own terms

credential_name.description: The vault name of the login the run uses, when it needs one

name.description: The AI's name; required and not empty

persona.description: The AI's persona; may be empty

steps.title: Read which AI identity rows the store already keeps
steps.do: Speak to the store in its own language, with the login under its credential_name, and read the AI identity rows already kept, one for each AI, with its name, persona, status and model. Submit where they are kept (or null) and how many rows were read.

steps.title: Make the store's own identity rows, once
steps.do: When the look step found none, make the store's own objects in its own form: one row per AI, keyed by its id, holding its name, persona, status and model id, with the status limited to pending_setup, active or disabled. Grant the person's login only what the store's holder allows. Submit the names of the objects made.

steps.title: Prove the rows on the example writes and seeds
steps.do: In a throwaway place in the same store, with the same objects, make these in order, each at the time given: [{"at": "2026-11-18T10:00:00Z", "write": {"id": "ai-1", "name": "Ada", "persona": "Patient and exact"}}, {"at": "2026-11-18T10:01:00Z", "write": {"id": "ai-1", "name": "", "persona": "x"}}, {"at": "2026-11-18T10:02:00Z", "write": {"id": "ai-2", "name": "Ben", "persona": ""}}, {"at": "2026-11-18T10:03:00Z", "write": {"id": "ai-1", "name": "Ada Lovelace", "persona": "Patient"}}, {"at": "2026-11-18T10:04:00Z", "seed": [{"id": "ai-3", "name": null, "status": "active", "model_id": "m1"}, {"id": "ai-4", "name": "Cy", "status": "bogus"}, {"name": "no id"}]}]. A write sets an AI's name and persona and keeps its other fields; a write whose name is empty is refused. A seed is a row another owner keeps (its name may be missing and its status may be unknown); a row with no id is not kept. Each write or seed must give the outcome the intent gives, and reading the AI identity rows back must give every expected answer below: a missing name reads as Assistant, a missing persona as empty, and a status that is not one of the three reads as pending_setup.

checks.says: Each write is kept or refused, and each seed is seeded
Reading the rows back gives each AI its name, persona, status and model, with the defaults the reader applies

steps.title: Keep this run's profile update
steps.do: Write the AI's name and persona to its own row, and read the row back. Submit outcome (kept, or refused with the store's words), and the row as it now reads.
